prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 96-120 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a massive red-brown tyrannosaur standing on two thick legs seen from the side, a huge heavy head with a deep jaw full of big teeth and a small orange eye, two tiny two-fingered arms, a heavy body held level, a thick tail curved up behind the hips, rough red-brown scales with a paler tan throat and belly; the whole dinosaur, tail tip to snout, sits in the middle of its own cell with empty space on both sides. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: its huge head with a small orange eye and big teeth is readable.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, snapping the huge head down low with the jaws wide open at the heroes, the head just above and in front of its front foot (not stretched out to the cell edge), both feet on the ground, the whole tyrannosaur well inside the middle cell, facing right.
- right cell: hurt, knocked back a step, still seen from the side facing right with the body level, the head pulled back a little, the eye squeezed shut and the jaws shut, both feet on the ground (not standing upright, not turned around), recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Use a strong diagonal line of action through the whole body: lower the huge head and open the jaws toward the heroes with the neck bent so the head stays just in front of the front foot, counter-swing the tail kept curved up close behind the hips, so every part stays well inside its own cell. Both feet stay on the ground. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, standing on two feet, both feet on the ground line. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, feathers, wings, four legs, olive green colour, brow horns, stripes, a rider, standing upright, a front view.
